prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art atlas for a top-down action game, EXACT 1024x1024, four equal 512x512 quadrants in a 2x2 grid. This is ONE Mars asset kit atlas. Everything must be authentic hand-placed-looking 16-bit PIXEL ART on an 8x8 output-pixel grid (logical canvas 128x128), hard pixel edges, no smoothing or painted gradients. Moody dark outlines, deliberate clustered shading, jewel-like highlights and restrained detailed materials inspired by the lush pixel craft of Momodora: Moonlit Farewell, but entirely original sci-fi content, no copied characters. TOP LEFT quadrant: an opaque seamless tile of dark burgundy/rust-red Martian regolith with subtle dusty pebbles and shallow irregular cracked soil; subdued contrast, no grid, no manufactured floor, no large obstacle, fill this quadrant edge to edge. TOP RIGHT quadrant: ONE original small squat living heap of rusty spacecraft garbage, bent tin shell, two asymmetrical expressive amber eyes, little claw feet, torn orange bag-like organic body, screws and broken antenna, disgusting but charming; broad garbage-monster archetype, NOT an existing Digimon character, no logos, no trash-bin character clone. The creature itself occupies the middle 256x256 pixels of this quadrant, with 128px transparent margin all around, seen from a top-down three-quarter RPG camera facing down/right. BOTTOM LEFT quadrant: ONE irregular cluster of rusty-red basalt boulders with layered iron-oxide facets, shape fills central 400px, same camera, no creature or manufactured blocks. BOTTOM RIGHT quadrant: ONE large boss of the same original species, imposing heap of layered scrap and oxidized rock, cracked copper plates and three amber eyes, original silhouette, occupies central 400px. The backgrounds of the three sprite quadrants must be TRUE transparent alpha; only the top-left terrain tile is opaque. Every subject stays strictly within its own quadrant, no captions, no lines, no borders, no text, no UI, no watermark. Overhead light from upper left, crisp single-pixel dark contour in the logical pixel grid. No blur or anti-aliasing.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one directional astronaut sprite atlas for a top-down pixel-art arena shooter. EXACT 1024x1024 with four equal 512x512 quadrants. TRUE transparent alpha background everywhere. Authentic low resolution 16-bit pixel art, visible hard square pixel clusters, no smoothing, 8x8 output-pixel grid as if a 128x128 logical sprite sheet enlarged exactly 8 times. Moody dark outlines, deliberate limited-color highlights and expressive detailed design compatible with lush handcrafted pixel art inspired by Momodora: Moonlit Farewell, but original science-fiction astronaut. Same single stocky astronaut in each quadrant, pearl/ivory worn space suit, small orange-red collar and sleeve stripe, dark navy reflective visor with one pale-cyan glint, rectangular oxygen backpack, little chunky boots, compact sidearm aimed in facing direction. Camera is top-down three-quarter RPG, character full body. The physical astronaut occupies ONLY the central 256x256 pixels inside each quadrant (128px transparent margins). TOP LEFT: facing downward toward viewer. TOP RIGHT: facing upward away from viewer, backpack visible. BOTTOM LEFT: facing left in three-quarter profile. BOTTOM RIGHT: facing right in three-quarter profile. All four views have identical proportions, foot baseline and scale. The design should be charming, readable at a 32-pixel final body height, not a smooth generic circle icon. No ground, no shadows painted outside silhouette, no text, no captions, no UI, no borders, no quadrant divider lines, no logo or watermark.
